name: DM-Ice
summary: DM-Ice17 deployed low-background NaI(Tl) detectors deep in Antarctic ice as a Southern Hemisphere direct-dark-matter demonstrator. The team later joined KIMS to form COSINE.
detection_principle: Long-term NaI scintillation readout in the stable deep-ice environment uses annual modulation to distinguish Galactic dark matter from seasonal backgrounds.

results.summary: Demonstrated remote calibration and operation of a low-background NaI detector in deep Antarctic ice.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
